experience.summary: Led a game-development team, ran Scrum delivery, and built Unity 2D, 3D, and AR prototypes for Android and iOS—improving delivery speed by 30%.
Designed a reusable Phaser prototyping system adopted for 15+ games, shipped six games with it, and maintained existing Unity projects.
Worked on 20+ 2D and 3D games using LibGDX, Unity, and Godot, including backend services, ads, IAP, cross-promotion, and multi-store publishing.
Contributed to web and software applications through implementation, code review, debugging, and testing.
